definitions.gloss: founder of a religion or sect; guru; (figuratively) originator
definitions.explanation: The person who founded a religion or religious sect, especially a new religious movement, and is revered by its followers. Figuratively, a leading figure who started a style or trend and has devoted followers: パンクの{教祖|きょうそ}.

examples.japanese: {教祖|きょうそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教祖|きょうそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The founder of the group was arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧「⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教祖|きょうそ}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧、⟦{熱狂的|ねっきょうてき}→熱狂的：21900_nekkyouteki⟧な⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Young people called him "the guru of fashion", and he won fanatical support.

notes:
Used mostly of new religions and cults, so it can carry a negative tone; for the founders of major religions, {開祖|かいそ} or ⟦{始祖|しそ}→始祖：12371_shiso⟧ is more usual.
